purpose: 论文B逆速度/状态空间公式、实际外部评价及分母的只读核对

scope.record_age_feature: not_used_by_B; local time centered at issue; canonical 180day retrospectively curated window not deployment age
scope.role: External terminal/main collapse kinematic transfer; local first mechanical initiation is a separate target.

model_formulas.tex: v_i=\left|\frac{\sum_{j=i-4}^{i}(t_j-\bar t_i)(d_j-\bar d_i)}{\sum_{j=i-4}^{i}(t_j-\bar t_i)^2}\right|,\quad u_i=v_i^{-1},\quad y_i=u_i/s,\quad s=\max\{\operatorname{median}_{i\in\mathcal W}|u_i|,10^{-30}\}.
model_formulas.meaning: 位移通道用最近5个实际观测时刻的局部回归斜率绝对值；Weissmiess已给mm/day速度，直接绝对值除24变为mm/h。W取发布前最近16个有限正速度；至少6个。角度与长度通道在各自站内归一，不形成跨站统一物理速度阈值。
采用固定alpha=2的局部运动学逆速度线性化；外部终末失稳与本地首次机械启动分别定义。
IV在t0发布，beta=(a,b)。实际最小二乘用numpy.linalg.lstsq，协方差用pinv并对称PSD截断。重叠5点速度窗口残差近似独立是估计分布假设。
SS是逆速度水平/逆速度趋势的局部线性状态空间，自编Kalman滤波；趋势不是原物理位移的直接加速度。0.001/0.1仅为预定敏感性，8/32点仅窗口敏感性。

model_formulas.tex: m_i^-=F_i m_{i-1},\ P_i^-=F_iP_{i-1}F_i^T+Q_i,\ K_i=P_i^-h^T/(hP_i^-h^T+R),\ m_i=m_i^-+K_i(y_i-hm_i^-),\ P_i=\operatorname{PSD}_{10^{-15}}[(I-K_i h)P_i^-].
model_formulas.meaning: 首3个窗口点回归初始化于第3点：m3=(截距,斜率)，P3=diag(10R,R/max{median(Δ)^2,10^-6})；依次滤过余下点，再从末个有效速度点按同F/Q传播到发布t0。估计R使用该发布前完整16点窗口；发布后的记录不用。
当前拟合逆速度均值非正时弃权。固定种子20261024产生4096个二维标准正态候选，取当前水平>0的前512个；不足512则弃权。每个模型共享固定候选池。非负趋势及超H根保留在1-p_H中；该概率是条件估计分布中的未来线性零点比例。

model_formulas.tex: I_H=[t_0+Q_{.025}(\tau\mid0<\tau\le H),\ t_0+Q_{.975}(\tau\mid0<\tau\le H)],\quad \hat T_H=t_0+Q_{.5}(\tau\mid0<\tau\le H),\quad P(\text{no zero in }H)=1-p_H.
model_formulas.meaning: 对512抽样中落入时域的有限根取经验分位；无有限根则p=0且时间区间/中位数为空。状态不一致/监测不足/失联时概率和区间均为空。SS抽的是发布时状态估计，不额外模拟发布后新的过程扰动；95%为此条件模型分布的中央区间。极少有限根可能产生很窄/零宽区间，表示Monte Carlo支持。

metric_definitions.meaning: 回放发布均早于标签下界L；[L,U]是来源失稳时间区间。仅确定二值标签且概率有限的机会评分；右删失负标签另需t0+H≤C。

metric_definitions.tex: C_{\rm full}=\mathbf1([L,U]\subseteq I_H),\qquad C_{\rm int}=\mathbf1([L,U]\cap I_H\ne\varnothing).
metric_definitions.meaning: 全标签包含与相交分别列出。已知阳性事件没有区间/弃权时，全机会包含记0；有区间子集另列分母。相交只是可能覆盖诊断。
预测的是条件中位时间；误差是该点到来源标签区间的距离，不选标签中点。分别报告这些误差的组均值和组中位数；有限中位时间且Y_H=1才可评分，分母另列。它不等于对未知精确时刻的绝对误差。
组内传感器等权、组间物理事件等权；配对表P只含IV和SS同时有概率且标签已知的相同site/issue/H。发布次数N不是独立物理事件数。
lower-safe lead以标签最早可能失稳L计。首次任意告警ell与首次正确时域内告警ell_in分开；中位/范围只在有对应告警组中计算，全部13病例机会同时列出。回放至L前截止，后失稳延迟不评分。

sampling_and_abstention.forecast_uncertainty: Local joint Gaussian estimation distribution conditioned on positive current inverse velocity. Future roots extrapolate straight current sampled state; no new post-issue SS process paths.

rolling_lead_interpretation.first_correct_in_horizon_alarm: First p≥.5 after source label is completely within futureH, not the initial alarm. H72hourly: each9/13; IVmedian60.241667h (24.99166667–71.866944), SSmedian62.241667h (24–71.491667).

right_censor_interpretation.negative_rule: Known negative iff issue+H≤17376h; horizons crossing followup remainunknown.
right_censor_interpretation.comparison: Nativefull-exposure andhourlylast30d differ in monitoring periods as well as schedule; interpret each condition separately.

conformal.interpretation: ceil((12+1)*.95)=13>12, so finite95split-conformal radius not supported; no replacement by maxfinite residual.

recommended_positive_text: 以相同发布机会比较两种运动学模型，并以物理事件等权汇总Brier分数。24小时任务中IV在两套发布方案均较低；48/72小时任务的排序随回顾窗口和发布方案变化。
在标签下界前24小时的固定截面，72小时条件区间分别完整包含IV3/13、SS6/13个失稳标签区间，有限条件区间数为7与8，概率输出数为10与11。
95%表示给定模型、当前正逆速度状态及未来时域内零点条件的中央区间；外部整标签包含、相交和不出区间机会分别列出。
右删失站提供一个独立的长期非终末失稳监测对照；每个未来时域均以随访端点确定是否可评分。

references.title: A Method to Predict the Time of Slope Failure Caused by Rainfall Using the Inverse Number of Velocity of Surface Displacement
references.read_scope: Publisher HTML bibliographic record and full English abstract, including acceleration–velocity relation, alpha=2 straight inverse-velocity line and zero-time interpretation. Japanese article body not claimed read. Publisher PDF request timed out in web; in-memory urllib obtained bytes but text extraction unavailable, so not used as full-text evidence.
references.supports: Original alpha2 inverse velocity foundation. This DOI belongs to the Japanese journal article, not the separate similarly named 1985 conference proceeding.
references.adoption: Cite the original journal article for the relation, then identify our OLS/SS/probability construction as this study implementation.

references.title: A method for prediction of volcanic eruptions
references.read_scope: Publisher HTML abstract, author/citation metadata and references, subscription-body preview only.
references.supports: General terminal material failure relation in an observable and its analytical use; this is not an implementation source for our SS noise/priors.

references.title: A Relation to Describe Rate-Dependent Material Failure
references.read_scope: Primary publisher URL 403; publisher-deposited Crossref DOI metadata independently retrieved to verify exact author/title/year/pages/DOI. UCL original-paper PDF retrieved into memory but extractor unavailable; no claim of full-text reading. Relation adopted here is supported directly by original Fukuzono publisher abstract and Voight1988 publisher abstract.
references.supports: Bibliographic correctness of material-failure original paper; background reference, not validation of local event timing.

references.title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
references.read_scope: Publisher-deposited Crossref bibliographic metadata; ASME article/PDF requests returned403. No full-text reading claim. Recursions above audited from actual local source and are our explicit linear-Gaussian implementation.
references.supports: Foundational Kalman filtering citation. Does not credit this original paper with our inverse-velocity state choice, noise estimate, fixed window or failure-time Monte Carlo.
